title: Medieval History Seminar 2027
level: PhD candidates and recent PhD recipients (2026/2027)
about: The German Historical Institute London (DHI London) calls for applications to the Medieval History Seminar 2027, held in London, United Kingdom, from 6 to 8 October 2027. Applications (CV, paper description, one recommendation letter) are sent as one PDF by email by 31 January 2027.
requirements: PhD candidates and recent PhD recipients (2026/2027) in medieval history from universities in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland and Germany
Ability to engage with contributions in both German and English
card_alt: Card for the Medieval History Seminar 2027 at the German Historical Institute London (DHI London) in London, United Kingdom; application deadline 31 Jan 2027. The photo shows Big Ben and Westminster Bridge in London.
